scope: Three reported Hebrew variants compared with local POB source records; no novel recovery or main-text changes.
rights_note: Only brief ancient-text excerpts, original comparison notes, citations, and existing POB snapshots are included; no archive images or full scholarly editions are vendored.

baseline.source_text_snapshot: וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א אִֽישׁ הַ/בֵּנַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מַּחֲנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים גָּלְיָ֥ת שְׁמ֖/וֹ מִ/גַּ֑ת גָּבְה֕/וֹ שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת וָ/זָֽרֶת־׃
baseline.translation_snapshot: Then a champion came out from the camps of the Philistines[a]; his name was Goliath, from Gath[b]. His height was six cubits and a span.

footnotes_snapshot.text: Hebrew: 'a man of the between,' likely referring to a representative fighter who steps out between the battle lines; hence 'champion.'
Six cubits and a span is approximately 9 feet 9 inches (about 3.0 meters), depending on the cubit used.

baseline.english_effect: His height was six cubits and a span.

comparison.role: direct-language manuscript, reading reported in scholarship
comparison.english_effect: His height was four cubits and a span.
comparison.english_type: illustrative rendering, not adopted POB text
comparison.locator: Hays p. 513; Helsinki study under 1 Samuel 17:4

records.caveat: Only the numeral is shown. No claim is made that the entire surrounding phrase survives intact. Cubit conversions are not used.

baseline.source_text_snapshot: בְּ/הַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּ/הַפְרִיד֖/וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְ/מִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
baseline.translation_snapshot: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance[a], when he separated the sons of man[b], he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.

footnotes_snapshot.text: Dead Sea Scrolls and the Septuagint read 'sons of God' (or 'angels of God') instead of 'sons of Israel.'
'The sons of man' is a Hebrew expression for human beings or humankind.

baseline.english_effect: according to the number of the sons of Israel

comparison.role: direct-language manuscript, reading reported in scholarship
comparison.english_effect: according to the number of the sons of God
comparison.english_type: illustrative rendering, not adopted POB text

records.caveat: Modern typesetting of a published witness reading, not a fresh diplomatic transcription. Greek sons/angels readings are versional controls. Scribal motives are not established.

baseline.source_text_snapshot: מַֽלְכוּתְ/ךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כָּל עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וּ֝/מֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּ/ךָ֗ בְּ/כָל דּ֥וֹר וָ/דֽוֹר־־׃
baseline.translation_snapshot: Your kingdom is a kingdom for all ages[a], and your dominion is throughout every generation.

footnotes_snapshot.text: Or “Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom.”
